capabilities: Start or join a live collaboration session on the current note from a view-header icon or command
Share a read-only link that lets others watch the document update live
Sync edits peer-to-peer at span granularity without overwriting concurrent edits
Watch the note on disk and merge changes made in external editors such as VS Code
Track session identity in the note frontmatter via a domd-id key
extras: macOS only (Apple Silicon or Intel) at this stage; the plugin is not yet in the community store and must be installed manually, though the companion desktop app is downloaded with one click if missing.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in real-time co-editing, and existing collaboration options require accounts or external services.

relations.evidence: The syncing is handled by DoMD, a small desktop app
edit the note in Obsidian, in VS Code, in whatever you like

summary: Peer-to-peer collaboration plugin that lets several people edit one note live, or share a read-only live view, with no account.
